name: Meghalayan Masala Tea
ingredients: 2 teaspoons high-quality black tea leaves (Assam variety)
instructions: 1. Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add the crushed ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and peppercorns to the boiling water.
3. Let the spices simmer for 3-4 minutes to extract their oils and flavors.
4. Add the black tea leaves and continue to boil for another minute.
5. Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a gentle boil until it reaches a desired color.
6. Stir in jaggery or honey according to your preference.
7. Strain the tea into cups and serve hot.
description: Meghalayan Masala Tea is a comforting beverage reflecting the cool, misty climate of the Khasi and Jaintia Hills. It emphasizes the use of fresh, locally grown spices, providing a soothing balance against the region's frequent rainfall and chilly mountain air.
